title: The health route answers
shows: A route whose condition is an exact path match, answered by the gateway itself. The simulator predicts the seed health route: 200 with no token check.

title: No route matches
shows: What a request that no route claims gets back. The simulator predicts a bare 404 with an empty body; the real gateway decides the body.

title: A protected route with no token
shows: The 401 and its WWW-Authenticate challenge from a route behind a resource-server filter. The challenge from the real gateway is linted by the same rules as the simulated one.

title: Dot-segments in the path
shows: Whether the gateway routes on the path as sent or after removing the dot-segments. The simulator keeps the raw path, so it predicts no route (404). A 200 would mean the real gateway normalised the path first.

title: A percent-encoded letter in the path
shows: Whether the gateway decodes the path before matching a route condition. The simulator keeps the raw path, so it predicts no route (404). A 200 would mean the real gateway decoded it.
